title: 313 Western Lake Drive | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Large Private Pool Located In Phase 1 Of WaterColor- 313 Western Lake by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: 313 Western Lake Drive by Royal Destinations Location: WaterColor-Phase One at Sunset Ridge Address: 313 Western Lake Drive Details: Featuring stunning furnishings, open indoor and outdoor living spaces, and a large private pool, 313 Western Lake Drive is one of the most luxurious custom estates in WaterColor. Located a short distance from the beach access, WaterColor neighborhood amenities, and the shops and boutiques of Seaside, the opportunities for nearby activities are endless. This home is a true jewel in the most sought-after location within the WaterColor community. Nestled among the trees in WaterColor Phase One, 313 Western Lake Drive is a world-class destination to accommodate the most discerning of travelers. No detail was overlooked within this 3-story spacious home. Bordering the ever-popular Highway 30A, there is a beautiful buffer of mature cypress and pines between you and Timpoochee trail, your link to all the villages along 30A. When you are not enjoying your private pool and outdoor living spaces, you are just a three-minute walk to the white sand and clear waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Within WaterColor, our guests will enjoy the ambience of great shopping and cuisine just around the corner. Everything is within walking or biking distance whether visiting the WaterColor Beach Club, FOOW, or a stroll to Seaside where more activities await! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 200 Yards -Distance to Town Center: 150 Yards -5,200 Sq. Ft. Heated and Cooled 7,500 Sq. Ft. with Porches and Decks -3 Living Rooms -3 Wet Bars -Parking Spaces: 3 -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 2, Outdoor Seating for 8 -Elevator -*Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 30’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. WaterColor Neighborhood Highlights: -Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. -WaterColor provides a free, on-demand trolley for guests, available daily with seasonal hours through the WaterColor Trolley app. For more information, contact our Reservations Team. -A 499-Acre Coastal Resort and Residential Community -Bike Community -Award-Winning Tennis Facilities -Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside Dining -Nearby State Parks and Preserves -4 Community Swimming Pools & Beach Club Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Home Configuration: Sleeps: 12 5 Bed / 1 Loft / 5 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (En Suite): King Bed/Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2 (En Suite): King Bed/Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) -Bedroom 3 (En Suite): Queen Bed/Private Bath (Shower) Second Floor: -Bedroom 4 (En Suite): King Bed/Private Bath (Shower and Soaking Tub) -Bunk Room with 2 sets of Twin over Twin Bunks and Twin Trundle -Laundry Room Third Floor: -Loft with Twin over Twin Bunk Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
